opportunities.name: Book-to-film unit note
opportunities.description: For a given classic book title, look it up on Project Gutenberg (author, download count), find its film adaptation on IMDb (year, rating), and save a 'Unit:' note summarizing both.
steps: Open Project Gutenberg and type {book_title} in the Quick search box, press Enter
Click the most-downloaded matching book result and read author and download count
Open IMDb, type {book_title} in the Search IMDb box (clear it first if needed), press Enter
Click the chosen film adaptation and read its year and rating
Open the Notes app, click 'New note'
Type 'Unit: {title} by {author} ({downloads} downloads). Film: {year}, rated {rating}' and press Enter

instances.values: Frankenstein — Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, 160188 downloads; film 2025, 7.4
Pride and Prejudice — Jane Austen, 192356 downloads; film 2005, 7.8
Treasure Island — Robert Louis Stevenson, 35366 downloads; film 1990, 7.0 (interrupted by a Wikipedia Morocco search)

opportunities.name: Country geography note
opportunities.description: For a given country, read its facts on Wikipedia (capital, population, languages, currency), get the capital's current local time on timeanddate.com, and save a 'Geography:' note.
steps: Open Wikipedia, type {country} in the Search Wikipedia box, press Enter
Read capital, population, languages and currency from the infobox
Open timeanddate.com, type {capital} in 'Search for city or place…', press Enter
Click the result matching {country}, {capital} and read the current local time and time zone
Open the Notes app, click 'New note'
Type 'Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop {population}, {languages}, {currency}, time now {time} {tz}' and press Enter

instances.values: Vietnam / Hanoi — pop 102,300,000, VND, 01:00:03 ICT (several mistyped searches first)

opportunities.name: Viator museum ticket lookup
opportunities.description: Search Viator for '{museum} tickets', skip date selection, and open the top ticket listing to check its price and details.
steps: Click the 'Search for a place or activity' box, select all and type '{museum} tickets', press Enter
Skip the date picker if it appears
Click the top or most relevant ticket listing in the results
Review the price, duration and rating (the person then tried OpenStreetMap, which returned 429 errors)

instances.values: Natural History Museum tickets → Field Museum of Natural History Admission ($29)
Louvre tickets → Paris Louvre 6-people Tour with Pre-Reserved Tickets ($66)
Rijksmuseum tickets → Rijksmuseum Ticket and Canal Cruise with Audio Guide ($44)
